summary:

Focus moves in on open, 35 Tabs and 12 Shift+Tabs stay inside, and Esc closes it with focus back on nav-biff. The CB overlay has role=dialog, aria-modal and aria-label; 60 Tabs stay inside; Esc closes it with focus back on door-comm. The guided modal (opened via door-court -> court-more-tools-toggle -> court-module-foundation) has role=dialog, aria-modal and aria-labelledby=guided-title-foundation; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside and Esc closes it, BUT focus returns to BODY, not the launcher. FORMS: /login passes everything (labels, login-error role=alert, aria-invalid + aria-describedby=login-error on both inputs,
, show-email toggle and magic link 24px, axe 0). /register passes everything (all 9 inputs named, inside main, register-submit-hint linked via aria-describedby, weak password -> register-form-error role=alert + password aria-invalid, date focus outline 2px solid, add-child 28px, all 4 strength levels pass axe). HEADINGS/FOOTER: portal home has a single visible h1 'Pick your path'. The CB h1 is 'Communication Builder' (hidden on mobile) and the brand is a

Rem text at 200% passes (BIFF chip 10px->20px, portal chips 10/11->20/22px). axe is 0 on login, login-error, register, register-error, help, calendar, portal home, case-settings, plan-options, CB overlay and guest AI notice. REMAINING FAILURES: CB reflow at 200% text and at 195px (quick exit off screen, brand wraps one letter per line); /register and portal home reflow at 200%/195px; colour contrast in the BIFF drawer and guided modal; the guided modal focus return. REGRESSION: both linked parents see the same banner. After a signed webhook (structured + professional + referral parallel_parenting) both see the professional text and plan-options-card -> /plan-options. Quick exit from /help goes to /calendar and Back does not return to /help. Admin export downloads safety_audit_log.csv, daily counts DOWNLOADS go up by 1, and there is no overflow at 390.

ui_bugs.issue: Reflow still fails. At 390 with root font 200%: cb-quick-exit is at left 289 / right 454 (off screen), the overlay scrollWidth is 482 vs 422, and 'SA CoParents' wraps one letter per line in a narrow column. At 195px CSS width: quick-exit right edge is 229 vs 195 and the brand wraps one letter per line again. RCA: the header row is a single non-wrapping flex row (back button shrink-0 + logo shrink-0 + brand min-w-0 + quick exit shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap ml-auto), so the brand shrinks to about 0 and the quick exit is pushed out. Fix: add flex-wrap to the row (or put quick exit on its own row on small screens), give the brand a min width such as min-w-[7rem] or basis-full, and drop whitespace-nowrap.
whitespace-nowrap pill in a non-wrapping justify-between row overflows: right edge 482 at 200% text and 239 at 195px. Add flex-wrap to the row and remove whitespace-nowrap.

When the modal is opened from court-module-foundation (court view), Esc closes it but focus lands on BODY instead of the launcher. RCA: opening the modal sets overlayOpen, which hides CourtOrderedView with display:none (JourneyShell hidden={overlayOpen...}). By the time useDialogFocus captures document.activeElement, the launcher is already hidden, so the opener is body. Fix: capture the opener before the state change (e.g. pass the trigger or store document.activeElement in openGuidedJourney), or don't hide the underlying view with display:none (use inert/aria-hidden). The same pattern probably affects any DrawerShell opened from a view that overlayOpen hides.

Root font 200% at 390: scrollWidth 448 vs 390. At 195px: 276 vs 195; the card and form get pushed wider. RCA (measured by hiding elements): the child name+age row (register-child-name-0 / register-child-age-0) is the main cause (276->236). The rest comes from the text-3xl 'SA CoParents' brand plus card-soft p-8 padding. Fix: add min-w-0/flex-wrap or w-full min-w-0 inputs to the child row, use smaller brand text and p-5 padding on narrow screens.

At 390 with root font 200%: scrollWidth 422 vs 390. The fixed bottom-nav (SacoparentsPortal.jsx:1680, px-6 justify-around, no wrap) has its right edge at 422, so the last nav item is clipped. The crisis strip (bg-rose-950/95 'In danger? Call 911') right edge is 398 and sonner toasts are at 406. At 195px: the 'Tool for either path' chip (WelcomeArtwork.jsx:52, fixed text-[7px] + whitespace-nowrap) and the bottom-nav overflow.

action_items: HIGH: fix the CB header reflow in SaChrome.jsx PageHeader: make the row flex-wrap, give the brand a minimum width, and keep cb-quick-exit on screen at 200% root font and at 195px width. Also wrap the DraftCard 'BIFF style' row.

Guided modal (and any overlay opened from a view hidden by overlayOpen): capture the opener before hiding the view, or hide it with inert instead of display:none, so Esc returns focus to court-module-* instead of BODY.
/register: let the child name/age row shrink (min-w-0 / flex-wrap) and reduce the brand size and card padding on narrow screens so 200% text and 195px have no horizontal scroll.
Portal home: let bottom-nav and the crisis strip wrap or shrink at 200% text; replace text-[7px] on WelcomeArtwork.jsx:52 with a rem size and allow wrapping.
Contrast: BiffTab.jsx slate-400 text (lines 165, 224, 309, 366) -> slate-500/600; BiffTab.jsx:40 emerald-600 -> emerald-700; guided-resume-discard button text darker.

Optional: give login-hide-email-toggle and login-forgot-password-link min-h-6. The legacy milestone tag shows 'ADVOCATE' for entries with source=advocate_review (BiffTab.jsx:322); show a neutral label instead.
critical_code_review_comments: useDialogFocus captures `document.activeElement` inside the effect, after the parent may already have hidden the trigger. Pass an explicit opener or record it at open time.
useDialogFocus's Tab trap filters with `offsetParent !== null`, which skips position:fixed focusables inside the dialog. Use getClientRects().length instead.

useDialogFocus `owns()` treats document.body as owned, so after focus is lost every open DrawerShell's listener would react to Esc/Tab. This is fine with one dialog but fragile if two DrawerShells stack.
BiffMilestones still maps source==='advocate_review' to an 'ADVOCATE' tag. Old saved entries would show advocate wording in the grey-rock UI.
